notes: re-scoped from the shared unit to sysml alone (ADR-0015)
decision: A transcription of SysML 8.2.2.16. The clause and the Xtext state this production identically — `ownedRelationship += OwnedReferenceSubsetting` in both — so there is nothing to weigh. A message event is nothing but a reference to the occurrence it names: it carries no keyword, no declaration and no body of its own, and everything that makes it an end of a message ('from', 'to', and the MessageEventMember wrapper) belongs to the productions around it. That is what lets the same subsetting reference serve as either end.

evidence.note: States the production; the rule is its transcription.

Line 781 `message of ignitionCmd:IgnitionCmd from driver.turnVehicleOn to vehicle.trigger1;` has a MessageEvent at each end: `driver.turnVehicleOn` and `vehicle.trigger1`, each an OwnedReferenceSubsetting over a feature chain.
Second opinion. Identical to the clause.
